body: Makes sense to me, but I think we need the GDExtension team to comment on this.

Thanks!

This looks good to me :-)

I did a quick test with this PR, printing out the info from `XRInterface.get_projection_for_view()` and `XRServer.remove_interface()`:

**Editor build:**

```
{ "name": "get_projection_for_view", "args": [{ "name": "view", "class_name": &"", "type": 2, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }, { "name": "aspect", "class_name": &"", "type": 3, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }, { "name": "near", "class_name": &"", "type": 3, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }, { "name": "far", "class_name": &"", "type": 3, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }], "default_args": [], "flags": 1, "id": 4326, "return": { "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 19, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 } }

{ "name": "remove_interface", "args": [{ "name": "interface", "class_name": &"XRInterface", "type": 24, "hint": 17, "hint_string": "XRInterface", "usage": 6 }], "default_args": [], "flags": 1, "id": 4409, "return": { "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 0, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 } }
```

**Release build:**

```
{ "name": "get_projection_for_view", "args": [{ "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 2, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }, { "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 3, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }, { "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 3, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }, { "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 3, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 }], "default_args": [], "flags": 1, "id": 4326, "return": { "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 19, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 } }

{ "name": "remove_interface", "args": [{ "name": "", "class_name": &"XRInterface", "type": 24, "hint": 17, "hint_string": "XRInterface", "usage": 6 }], "default_args": [], "flags": 1, "id": 4409, "return": { "name": "", "class_name": &"", "type": 0, "hint": 0, "hint_string": "", "usage": 6 } }
```

As expected, the only thing missing in the release build is the argument names, but all the type, usage and hint info is still there.
